name: LogiNova
author: PlaceTheCode

sections.description:
LogiNova transforms the standard WordPress login and registration experience by providing stylish popup windows. Users can login, register, and recover passwords without leaving the page they’re on.

Key Features:

  • AJAX-powered login and registration – no page reloads
  • Customizable popup design with extensive styling options
  • Redirect users to specific pages after login/logout
  • Custom error messages
  • Terms and conditions consent option
  • Password recovery functionality
  • Responsive design works on all devices

Privacy Policy

LogiNova uses cookies to keep users logged in and may store IP addresses for security purposes. It does not share any data with external services.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the loginova folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to ‘LogiNova’ in your admin menu to configure settings
sections.faq:
How do I add login/register links to my menu?

The plugin automatically adds login/register links to your navigation menu.

Can I customize the appearance of the popup?

Yes! The plugin includes extensive styling options. Go to LogiNova → Styles in your WordPress admin to customize colors, sizes, fonts, and more.

Does this work with custom user roles?

Yes, the plugin uses WordPress’s built-in authentication system, so it works with all user roles.
